sections.label: GIP investments and EDB assessment
sections.summary: From 2011 to 2016 GIP investors brought $1.8 billion in business expenditure and over 6,000 jobs, with EDB assessing applicants and their plans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: From 2011 to 2016, GIP investors brought in $1.8 billion in total business expenditure via direct investments, generating over 6,000 job opportunities in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Industries that have benefited include infocomm media, engineering and financial services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: To qualify under the GIP, applicants may invest in a business or in a GIP fund that invests in Singapore-based companies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: Each applicant is required to submit detailed plans and supporting documents to the Economic Development Board (EDB).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: EDB assesses the applicant's track record, business and investment plans, and potential contribution to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade))
sentences.text: EDB also engages a risk assessment consultancy firm to undertake independent checks and works with relevant agencies for security screening.

sections.label: GIP objective and fund total
sections.summary: The GIP aims for Singapore-based companies to benefit from GIP fund capital and investors' entrepreneurial track record, with total GIP funds at $1.5 billion as of 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: The primary objective of the GIP is for Singapore-based companies to benefit from the injection of capital from GIP funds and tap on the GIP investors' entrepreneurial track record to inject dynamism into our economy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: I can share that, as of 2017, the total GIP funds amount to $1.5 billion, but in terms of the performance, this would vary from fund to fund because each fund would have their respective mandate to invest in different sectors of focus.

sections.label: GIP minimum investment amount
sections.summary: The minimum investment required under the GIP is $2.5 million.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: For example, the minimum investment required under GIP is $2.5 million.
